assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Coordinate axes with the parabola y = x^2/2 + 7/2, the blue line y = x + 7 and the green line y = x; three dashed blue circles of radius 2 sqrt 2 centred at (1, 4), (5, 16) and (-3, 8) touch the blue line, and two thin green circles centred on the parabola at x = 1 - sqrt 2 and x = 1 + sqrt 2 touch the green line.

difficulty_rationale: Reduce tangency to a distance condition and count roots of a quadratic in the parameter; the parity condition fixes the radius.
